en: Black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a busy riverside or harbor scene in winterless weather. A truck loaded high with parcels and mail sacks stands on a wooden quay while men in uniforms and bowler hats load and throw packages. To the left is a passenger boat flying a Scandinavian-style flag, with seated passengers. In the distant background across the water stands a prominent church with a dome and tower surrounded by trees. Handwritten text runs along the top border of the card.
